title: Linear regression prediction
instruction:
You have data showing years of experience and salary. Train a LinearRegression model, predict the salary for 8 years of experience, and print the prediction rounded to the nearest integer.

Years: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]
Salary: [30, 35, 38, 42, 48, 52, 58, 68, 75]
starter_code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

X = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]).reshape(-1, 1)
y = np.array([30, 35, 38, 42, 48, 52, 58, 68, 75])

# Train model and predict for 8 years
solution_code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

X = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]).reshape(-1, 1)
y = np.array([30, 35, 38, 42, 48, 52, 58, 68, 75])

model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)
pred = model.predict([[8]])
print(int(round(pred[0])))

title: k-NN classification on iris-like data
instruction:
Train a KNeighborsClassifier (k=3) on the following data. Predict the class for a new sample [5.0, 3.5, 1.5, 0.3] and print the predicted class.

Features: sepal_length, sepal_width, petal_length, petal_width
Classes: 0 = setosa, 1 = versicolor, 2 = virginica
starter_code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier

X = np.array([
    [5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2],
    [4.9, 3.0, 1.4, 0.2],
    [6.2, 2.9, 4.3, 1.3],
    [5.5, 2.5, 4.0, 1.3],
    [6.3, 3.3, 6.0, 2.5],
    [5.8, 2.7, 5.1, 1.9],
])
y = np.array([0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2])

new_sample = np.array([[5.0, 3.5, 1.5, 0.3]])

# Train k-NN and predict
solution_code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier

X = np.array([
    [5.1, 3.5, 1.4, 0.2],
    [4.9, 3.0, 1.4, 0.2],
    [6.2, 2.9, 4.3, 1.3],
    [5.5, 2.5, 4.0, 1.3],
    [6.3, 3.3, 6.0, 2.5],
    [5.8, 2.7, 5.1, 1.9],
])
y = np.array([0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2])

new_sample = np.array([[5.0, 3.5, 1.5, 0.3]])

knn = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=3)
knn.fit(X, y)
pred = knn.predict(new_sample)
print(pred[0])
